messages:
maria: FYI I started a compact migration guide draft for v1 -> v2 focused on "minimal-steps" for product teams. Need cross-language smoke examples and a short section on model alias swaps. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4210 :wave:
kevin: Nice. Can you include a tiny CLI curl example we can paste into CI? Keep it single-line and checkable via exit codes.
jo: i'll write short snippets for JS + Python. can someone take Go and Rust?
sam: i'll do Go. prefer to show the synchronous call only here; we'll add streaming examples in the realtime guide.
maria: good. here's the core python snippet for the migration smoke test (very small):
maria: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
resp = client.responses.create(model="redwood-v2", input="Hello world")
print(resp.output_text)
```
kevin: looks good. small editorial nit: mention that "responses.create" replaces the old "invoke" call and link to the API diff. also call out embedding alias dim change under breaking-changes.
jo: adding JS example now. using promise shorthand to keep it tiny.
jo: ```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const resp = await client.responses.create({ model: 'redwood-v2', input: 'Summarize this' })
console.log(resp.output_text)
```
sam: pushed Go snippet to branch. i used CreateResponse based on the v2 SDK naming. Also added a note: reindex embeddings if you switch alias from redwood-embed-v1 -> redwood-embed-v2 (dims differ).
docops-bot: link-linter detected a 404 in the draft: /guides/old-embeddings -> should be /guides/embeddings/migration. Suggested auto-fix in PR comments.
kevin: oof good catch. i updated the anchor link and left a comment asking for a short paragraph on client default timeouts — v2 default is now 60s (was 30s). callers might want to tune for long-running tasks.
maria: added a "risk matrix" bullet list for common gotchas: header changes for webhooks, param renames, embedding dim changes, and default timeout increase.
jo: question: do we need to include a short note about model fallback policies? e.g., how hosted routing may choose redwood-v2-small when v2 is throttled.
sam: yes, add a sentence and link to the routing doc. i'll add an example policy snippet in a follow-up PR.
kevin: CI smoke test suggestion: single-line curl that checks HTTP 200 and non-empty output: `curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"ok"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses | jq -e '.output_text'` — exit 0 if present.
docops-bot: spellcheck: "reindex" -> "re-index" in one place. minor.
maria: will fix wording. also request: someone validate the Rust sample. we don't have a regular Rust maintainer.
jo: i can do a light syntax check but prefer an actual Rust user to sanity-check types. tagging @sam for review when available.
sam: i'll review Rust when pushed. also, can QA run the curl smoke test against the staging docs deploy after merge?
ci-bot: docs staging deploy scheduled after merge. please ensure PR has all fixes.
kevin: small follow-up: add an "upgrade checklist" at top with 5 items (update SDK, update alias, re-index embeddings, run smoke, monitor latency). makes rollouts easier.
maria: done in the branch. final ask: let's keep examples minimal—most readers copy/paste. no heavy error handling in snippets. reviewers: @kevin @jo @sam. aiming to merge today if no blocking comments. :thumbsup:
kevin: reviewing now, will approve after two micro-edits.
